product.name: Custom Socks
product.description: Complete your team's uniform with custom socks built to match your look. Choose from a range of knit and printed options to create a coordinated design in your team colors. Bold graphics and vibrant colors help your team stand out on the field. Orders having less than 10 pairs are subject to a minimum order fee of $25.
product.leadTime: Mockup Lead Time: 2-4 business days after order is placed. Ships: 2 weeks after artwork approval.
